title: RCCG Dayspring Chapel, 'The Dayspring' v3 (emotional ElevenLabs read)
engine: ElevenLabs, model eleven_v4 (pinned), stability 0.0 (Creative = most expressive). Cast per voice-selection-sop.md: 3 warm narrator voices x 2 seeds, score_takes.py, best take per beat.
arc: pain (sad, aching, ashamed, hollow) -> stern turn -> skeptical question answered -> reverent scripture -> awe at the dawn -> warm pride -> joy -> curious, gentle, excited future pace -> relief -> warm invitation

beats.text: [softly, heavy-hearted] You've been carrying it alone... {sigh} for a long time.
[quiet, aching] The late nights.
[low, ashamed] The habit you hide.
[voice catching] The words you can't take back.
[tight, bitter] The bitterness you keep calling... fine.
[hollow, sad] That empty feeling... after the party ends.
[almost a whisper, sorrowful] And that quiet ache... that nothing fixes.
[stern, leaning in] But hear me.
[firm, then softening] You are not too far gone.
[skeptical, questioning] You think it's too late?
[warm, certain] It's not. And it's not too much, either.
[reverent, slow] Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden,
[tenderly] and I will give you rest.
[awed, rising] The dayspring from on high... hath visited us.
[warm, proud] Dayspring Chapel. A parish of The Redeemed Christian Church of God, right here in Houston.
[bright, inviting] A home in Houston. Service times, directions, a plan for your first Sunday.
[warm, respectful] Pastors Joel and Funmi Uzoma. Together in ministry since nineteen ninety-five.
[joyful] Every nation. One family.
[curious, leaning in] So... picture this Sunday.
[gentle, smiling] Ten thirty. Somebody's holding the door for you.
[excited, building] The first song starts...
[relieved] You sit down. {sigh} And you finally breathe.
[firm, encouraging] So bring it. [softly] Set it down.
[warm, smiling] Come as you are.
[upbeat, clear] Sunday worship, ten thirty. Plan your visit at R C C G dayspring dot org.
